hypothesis_description: Pilot 4 결과 (L-193): Task #26 breadth 제약은 portfolio construction 정상화했으나 Market exposure 48% (Gate D FAIL) + Active IR -1.311 (BM 대비 초과수익 실패). 본 Pilot 5는 Pilot 4 기본 구조(RAPC alpha + Ledoit-Wolf risk + MVO breadth-constrained)를 상속하고, Market hedge overlay를 도입. 가설: KOSPI200 beta-target 0.8 (또는 KOSPI200 index short 20%) overlay를 추가하여 market risk contribution을 48%→30%로 축소하면 Active IR 개선(-1.31→>-0.5 목표)이 가능한가. BM-relative 성과 개선이 절대 성과 희생을 정당화할 수 있는가를 실증한다.

constraint_overrides.min_names_rationale: Pilot 4 lessons (L-193): min_names=15 hard floor + lambda_retries 4 exhaustion + forced alpha-top filling degraded active IR (-1.003 → -1.311). Pilot 5 softens floor to 10, letting optimizer self-select 10~20 via bounds[0,0.10] + hhi_cap=0.10 natural diversification. Hard cap max_names=20 unchanged.

hedge_overlay.rationale: Pilot 4 Gate D FAIL (Market 48%). Pilot 5 targets KOSPI200 beta 0.8 via (a) long-only beta-neutralized MVO tilt OR (b) KOSPI200 index short 20% overlay (Risk Agent choice).

evaluation_windows.judge_added_note: Judge Agent appended evaluation_windows block (inherited from Pilot 4 WT-D20260424_002 request.json) to support judge_oos_helper. Alpha/Risk/Optimizer packages NOT redefined. Non-destructive augmentation only.
